index.title: As I See You - a 3x3 photo collage of someone you love
index.desc: "My girlfriend, as I see her." Describe someone through nine topics and fill each square with a photo — make the trending 3x3 picture on your phone.
index.h1: If they were nine things, what would they be?
index.lead: Animal, place, food, color… Make the "as I see you" 3x3 picture just by picking photos, then show it to them in your story or a chat.
index.note: Free to use (with ads). Requires iOS 18 or later on iPhone, Android 10 or later on Android.
index.feat1.p: Animal, place, plant, character, season, hobby, food, color, drink. Answer "if they were an animal…?" one square at a time with photos from your library.
index.feat2.h: Paint a square with a color
index.feat2.p: Instead of a photo, you can fill a square with a single color.
index.feat3.p: Cut out just the person or object and place it on white — perfect for the character square. The original is kept, so you can undo anytime.
index.feat4.p: Choose your own nine topics and save them as a set to use again and again.
index.feat5.h: Hand your topics to a friend with a QR code
index.feat5.p: Turn a topic set into a QR code and just show it. When they scan it, the app opens on their phone and they can make a board with the same topics. Only the topics and colors go in — never your photos.
index.feat6.p: Export the finished image (3:4) together with the blank topic sheet, then save or share them.
index.feat7.h: Your photos stay on your device
index.feat7.p: The photos you pick and your boards are stored only on your device. They are never sent to our servers.
index.step1: Pick a title (like "My girlfriend, as I see her") and a topic set to make a board
index.step2: Tap a square to choose a photo or a color. Pinch to resize, drag to move
index.step3: Tap "Export" to make the images, then save or share them
index.privacy.p: No sign-up. Photos, boards and topic sets are handled only on your device. The only information that leaves it is what is needed to show ads (Google AdMob). See the Privacy Policy for details.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy - As I See You
privacy.desc: Privacy Policy of As I See You. Your photos and boards never leave your device. This page explains the information handled for ads (Google AdMob).
privacy.meta: As I See You / Effective November 3, 2026
privacy.lede:
Summary
As I See You has no sign-up and never asks for your name or email address. The photos you pick, the boards you make and your topic sets are handled only on your device and are never sent to the developer's servers. The only information that leaves your device is what is needed to show ads (Google AdMob).
privacy.s1.p:
Provider: Ryo Tsuzukihashi (independent developer / TsuzuKit)
App: As I See You (私から見たあなた)
Scope: the iPhone and Android app, and the pages under https://tsuzukit.com/asiseeyou/ including this one
Contact: ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com
privacy.s2.p:
The following is stored in the app's storage on your device. The developer cannot see it.
  • Boards (title, photos and colors in the nine squares, topics, photo position and size, date created)
  • Topic sets you made
  • Exported images (until you save or share them)
Photos. To pick photos, the app uses the standard photo picker on iPhone and the system photo picker on Android. The app receives only the photos you choose and does not ask for access to your whole photo library. It asks for permission to add to Photos only when you save exported images.
Background removal. This uses Apple Vision on iPhone and Google ML Kit on Android, and runs on your device. Your photos are never sent anywhere (on Android, Google Play services may download the component this feature uses).
Sharing a topic set. The QR code or link contains only the set's name, the topic text and colors — no photos. You choose who to give it to.
privacy.s3.h: 3. What is sent off your device (ads)
privacy.s3.p:
To keep the app free, it shows ads from Google AdMob, provided by Google LLC (a banner at the bottom of the screen, and a full-screen ad after exporting). To show ads, AdMob handles the following:
  • Device information such as device type, OS version and language
  • IP address and the approximate region derived from it
  • Whether an ad was shown or tapped
  • On iPhone, the advertising identifier (IDFA), only if you choose "Allow" on the tracking prompt at launch, so that ads can be personalized. If you choose "Ask App Not to Track", every feature still works
On Android, the app does not use the Advertising ID and shows only non-personalized ads.
In the European Economic Area, the UK and Switzerland, Google's consent form is shown before any ad is loaded, and no ads are loaded without consent.
Ads are limited to content suitable for all ages. For how Google handles information, see Google's Privacy Policy and How Google uses information from sites or apps that use its services.
Transfers abroad. Google LLC is a US company, and the information above is processed on servers in the US and elsewhere. Google protects it under its own privacy policy.
privacy.s4.h: 4. What the app does not use
privacy.s4.p: The app does not use location, contacts, the camera or the microphone. It has no analytics or crash reporting.
privacy.s5.p: The information is used only to show ads so the app can stay free. It is not used for anything else, and it is never given to third parties without your consent except as required by law.
privacy.s6.p:
Deleting the app removes all boards and topic sets from your device. Images you saved to Photos can be deleted in the Photos app.
On iPhone, you can stop the use of the advertising identifier at any time in Settings → Privacy & Security → Tracking.
privacy.s7.p: tsuzukit.com, including this page, uses Google Analytics to understand traffic and Google AdSense for ads. They collect information using cookies. You can refuse cookies in your browser settings.
privacy.s8.p: The app is not primarily directed at children, but it can be used at any age. Ads are limited to content suitable for all ages.
privacy.s9.p: When the app's features or the services it uses change, this page will be updated. Significant changes will be announced on this page.
privacy.contact: For questions about this policy, please use the contact form or email ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com.
